chemistry-killer-06.title: Isku-xirka ionic, isku-xirka covalent iyo oksidhaysho-yaraynta
chemistry-killer-06.topic: Isku-xirka ionic, isku-xirka covalent iyo oksidhaysho-yaraynta
chemistry-killer-06.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-06.material:
Xadka isbeddelka midabka ee indicators-ku waa sidan.
Methyl orange: pH < 3.1 casaan, 3.1 ~ 4.4 liin, pH > 4.4 huruud
BTB: pH < 6.0 huruud, 6.0 ~ 7.6 cagaar, pH > 7.6 buluug
Phenolphthalein: pH < 8.3 midab la'aan, 8.3 ~ 10.0 midab ruuxi ah, pH > 10.0 casaan
Kuwani waa natiijooyinka marka saddex indicator mid mid loogu dhibciyay saddex xal oo nolol maalmeedka ka mid ah.
(I) Xalka moodelka acid-ka calool: methyl orange casaan, BTB huruud, phenolphthalein midab la'aan
(II) Xalka lagu daray antacid ku filan oo la falgaliyay: methyl orange huruud, BTB huruud, phenolphthalein midab la'aan
(III) Xal sodium bicarbonate la qasiyay: methyl orange huruud, BTB buluug, phenolphthalein midab la'aan
Marka la go'aamiyo xadka pH ugu cidhiidhsan ee buuxiya natiijooyinka saddexda indicator dhammaantood, waa kuwee, si isku xigta, xadka pH ee (I), (II), iyo (III)?
